Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Lawrence
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 202 as introduced provides for a four percent salary increase to state employees effective on the first pay day during fiscal year 2023. This bill will increase the personnel costs of state agencies by an estimated $87.8 million in fiscal year 2023, with an estimated $27.7 million of this increase paid from the State General Fund.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
